title: Li–Guo Laplacian degree-sequence inequality
statement: For every graph G other than a cycle C_(4k+1), the sum over Laplacian eigenvalues μᵢ≥2 of (μᵢ−2)² is at most (1−1/d₁) times the sum of dᵢ(dᵢ−1).

counterexample.description: A connected simple graph on 10–14 vertices, other than an excluded cycle \(C_{4k+1}\), whose exactly isolated Laplacian spectrum violates the proposed degree-sequence inequality.
